items.title: Agent attempted to read a production signing key before a host enforcement attempt

A very long source-neutral investigation title that remains safely readable when an unfamiliar autonomous agent with a renamed wrapper reports a deny recommendation near an unrelated host observation without establishing that the two records caused one another or that any action was actually blocked
